title: DS-DATA-02 chunked numerical particle trajectory
description: Q-I storage contract for an already materialized HDF5 trajectory. This schema does not grant Q-N or production eligibility.

time.description: One finite, strictly increasing saved time per frame; unit s.

particle_id.description: Static Idp axis when per-frame identity arrays are absent.

particle_zone.description: Static Zone axis paired with particle_id.

particle_id_by_frame.description: Optional per-frame Idp axis; must be paired with particle_zone_by_frame.

particle_zone_by_frame.description: Optional per-frame Zone axis; must be paired with particle_id_by_frame.

valid.description: Binary 0/1 activity mask. False rows are padding and are excluded from finite/positive checks.

position.description: Position in an explicitly named coordinate frame, unit m.

velocity.description: Velocity in the same explicitly named coordinate frame, unit m/s.

density.description: Active values finite and >0, unit kg/m^3.

mass.description: Active values finite and >0, unit kg.

pressure.description: Optional active pressure field; if present its unit and source must be explicit.

type.description: Particle class. Type 3 is fluid and type 2 is floating body; their mass ledgers are separate.

mk.description: Optional material/zone marker; it is not a substitute for typed (Zone,Idp) identity.

x-semantics.closed_system: Check every frame for missing and revived identities; first/last retention alone is insufficient.
x-semantics.dimension: solver_dimension must come from an explicit solver output/parameter or bound metadata; coordinate_components=3 and z values are not evidence of 3D.
x-semantics.missing_information: Absent units, coordinate frame, geometry, control, rigid-body state, or boundary/flux semantics remains missing evidence.
x-semantics.memory: Readers must process the time/particle axis in bounded chunks and must not load a complete trajectory into memory.
